payload.why_now: 记录中的复测时间已到：此前分析建议约8周后在同一实验室复测；这次结果让“新剂量后是否在回落”有了初步可比较的信息。

judge.reason: Surfacing was appropriate: the newly recorded TSH of 3.1 mIU/L can be compared with the verified earlier Lab A result of 6.2 mIU/L, and the new note identifies the lab as the same one. The candidate describes a decrease without claiming the dose caused it or declaring the result normal. It identifies what remains unanswered and how another same-lab TSH result and the lab’s reference range would inform follow-up.
